rows: [INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] <urn:nltl:generated-shape:TRF-058_WebFrameShape>/sh:or: The candidate requires every targeted webFrame to have supportedStringerOutsideIceBelt explicitly set to either true or false, and the false branch makes that selector mandatory even when the requirement is not applicable. The requirement imposes a condition only when the supported stringer is outside the ice belt and does not mandate recording a false applicability value.
